_doc: AlifeAmbience candidate source-pool registry for the LEGACY standalone soundpool.py (inventory + select). The authoritative source list for the shipped build is merge.py MODS; only DarkSigWeather, Soundscape Overhaul, RETUNE, and Dark Signal Amplified actually ship (see provenance.tsv). AudioExpansion and RealDistMutants are candidates that contributed nothing to the build. 'root' points at a gamedata/sounds tree. 'priority' is a tie-break only (lower wins) per architecture invariant I5; true quality is decided by spectral rolloff, not this number.

_include_roots_doc: Only files whose top-level dir under a pool's sounds/ root is listed here are inventoried. The ambient channel system (sound_channels.ltx) references only these trees; monsters/, interface/, material/, actor/, device/, music/, weapons/, etc. belong to other sound systems and are out of scope for this mod.
_categories_doc: First matching substring (checked in listed order, case-insensitive, on the path relative to the pool root) sets the category. 'prefer' is the wanted channel layout: 'mono' for sharp directional cues (the engine pans a mono point-source by bearing), 'stereo' for wide ambient beds, 'any' for no preference. This is a ranking preference, NOT a fitness gate (invariant I4); stereo is used for a mono-preferred category when no mono candidate exists, and vice versa.
